items.heading: IT Is a Good Career
items.text: IT Is a Good Career IT Is a Good Career It is a good career with a bad front door. The work is varied, the pay at senior level is strong, and the skills move to freelance, studios and consulting. The front door is narrow: companies hire fewer juniors than the number of people who finish courses.

items.heading: Choose the Route That Builds
items.text: Choose the route that builds a high-value skill portfolio fastest: one core skill (product design), one multiplier (a domain such as fintech or health, or front-end basics) and visible proof that a stranger can open. That stack is what unlocks stronger income opportunities, not the route's name.

visuals.heading: What a Product Designer Actually Owns

rows: Talking to customers, reading support tickets, watching recordings, writing down the real problem in one sentence.
A one-page problem brief backed by 5 to 8 real conversations.
AI can sort and summarise notes. It cannot sit across from a nervous shop owner and notice what they did not say.
Flows, wireframes, states (empty, error, loading), prototypes that people can click and break.
A clickable prototype plus notes on what failed when real people tried it.
First drafts of flows now take minutes. Choosing which flow is right for this business is still yours.
Type, spacing, colour, icons, motion. Making a tested structure feel trustworthy.
Before and after screens with the reason for each change.
Generated screens look polished and generic. A taste that fits one brand is the part that sells.
Components, tokens, naming, documentation so ten designers and a dozen engineers build the same thing.
A small, documented component library used in a real project.
Tools can propose components. Keeping a system consistent as a product grows is slow human work.

items.heading: Uceed
items.text: UCEED: a 3-hour test run from IIT Bombay. Registration for UCEED 2027 is listed as 1 to 31 October 2026, exam on 17 January 2027, results 6 March 2027 (official UCEED site).

items.heading: Nid
items.text: NID: the admissions site lists a 30 November 2026 deadline for the 5.5-year integrated pathway at Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Bengaluru. Careers360 reports DAT Prelims on 20 December 2026, a Mains in April or May 2027, and 19 Product Design seats among 147 at Ahmedabad. Confirm all details in the official handbook.
